title: Bayesian Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with Abstention
abstract: arXiv:2610.30384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the Bayesian fixed-confidence best-arm identification problem in which a learner can abstain from making a terminal recommendation. Subject to a target error probability $\delta$ and an abstention budget $\alpha$, we propose Screen-and-Confirm (S&C) and analyze its expected stopping time. We further derive the minimum expected stopping time for any algorithm that satisfies these constraints. For Gaussian priors and rewards, as $(\delta,\alpha)\downarrow(0,0)$, we establish matching upper and lower bounds up to multiplicative constants, with rate $\kappa_\nu^2[1+\log((\alpha+\delta)/\delta)]/(\alpha+\delta)$, where $\kappa_\nu$ is the prior density of the top-two gap at zero, highlighting that nearly tied instances govern the sampling cost. When abstention is disallowed ($\alpha=0$), S&C yields the optimal $\Theta(1/\delta)$ dependence for fixed model parameters, removing the additional $\log(1/\delta)$ factor in the upper bound

translated_title: 带弃权机制的贝叶斯固定置信度最优臂识别
translated_abstract: 我们研究了贝叶斯固定置信度最优臂识别问题，其中学习者可以选择放弃做出最终推荐。在目标错误概率 $\delta$ 和弃权预算 $\alpha$ 的约束下，我们提出了筛选与确认（Screen-and-Confirm, S&C）算法并分析其期望停止时间。我们进一步推导了满足这些约束的任何算法的最小期望停止时间。对于高斯先验和奖励，当 $(\delta,\alpha)\downarrow(0,0)$ 时，我们建立了在乘性常数意义下匹配的上下界，其速率为 $\kappa_\nu^2[1+\log((\alpha+\delta)/\delta)]/(\alpha+\delta)$，其中 $\kappa_\nu$ 是前两名臂差距在零处的先验密度，这突出表明近乎平局的实例主导了采样成本。当不允许弃权（$\alpha=0$）时，S&C算法在固定模型参数下达到了最优的 $\Theta(1/\delta)$ 依赖关系，去除了上界中额外的 $\log(1/\delta)$ 因子。
tldr: 该论文提出了带弃权机制的贝叶斯固定置信度最优臂识别算法S&C，证明了其期望停止时间在高斯设置下达到匹配的上下界，揭示近乎平局的实例主导采样成本，并在无弃权时达到最优的 Θ(1/δ) 依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Screen-and-Confirm (S&C) algorithm for Bayesian fixed-confidence best-arm identification with abstention, establishing matching upper and lower bounds on expected stopping time showing that nearly tied instances govern the sampling cost, and achieving optimal Θ(1/δ) dependence when abstention is disallowed.
